externalEtcd.productionRecoveryDecision: A production Kubernetes recovery must fence old API/etcd clients and restore onto isolated prepared capacity using a sufficient revision bump and --mark-compacted before reopening; the no-bump rehearsal compares the original snapshot revision. No production restore or downgrade performed.

nodeRecovery.scope: Decrypt independent immutable archive; restore files into isolated capacity preserving numeric owner/group/modes and checksums; validate key/certificate pairs; prove recovered SSH identity can access node independently of the Kubernetes API. No production restore, node reconstruction or kubeadm downgrade was performed.
